title: World Disaster Information Center
summary: Follow typhoons, earthquakes, and other disasters worldwide. Choose an event to read available agency reports or see conditions through nearby cameras in Taiwan.
controls: Select an event, choose an agency, or use the camera filter to find nearby streams.
limitations: Agency reports depend on the event and jurisdiction. The camera directory currently covers Taiwan.

approval.note: Creator approved the renamed application and requested updated Possibility artwork and catalog copy.

summaryZhTW: 全球災害資訊站彙整世界各地的颱風、地震等災害通報。選取事件，查看不同機關發布的資訊；若事件鄰近臺灣的公開攝影機，也能觀看當地即時影像。
coverAlt: WDIC poster showing a Pacific cyclone, a volcanic arc, and golden seismic waves over a globe.
